'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
*****Israeli attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]] kill at least 72 [[Palestinians]] amidst the ongoing offensive to capture [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/10/live-israels-deadly-attack-on-hamas-in-qatar-draws-global-condemnation (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[September 2025 Israeli attacks in Yemen]]
****[[Israel]] carries out a series of [[airstrike]]s against alleged [[Houthi]] targets and civilian structures in [[Sanaa]] and [[Al Jawf Governorate]], [[Yemen]], killing 35 people and wounding 131 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/10/israel-attacks-yemen-capital-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia-NATO relations]], [[Poland-Russia relations]]
***[[2025 Russian drone incursion into Poland]], [[Violations of non-combatant airspaces during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****The [[Polish Air Force]] and [[NATO]] allies scramble fighter jets in response to 19 [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] penetrating up to 250 km into [[Poland|Polish]] [[airspace]] during an overnight air attack on [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c147065pzdzo (BBC News)] 
****The [[Polish Armed Forces]] confirms it has shot down four Russian drones over the country, marking the first time Poland has directly engaged Russian military assets since the start of the war. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c147065pzdzo (BBC News)]
****Poland closes multiple airports due to the airspace breach, including [[Warsaw Modlin Airport]], [[Rzeszów–Jasionka Airport]], and [[Lublin Airport]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/09/europe/poland-scramble-jets-russian-drone-reports-intl-hnk-ml (CNN)]
****[[Prime Minister of Poland|Polish prime minister]] [[Donald Tusk]] invokes Article 4 of the [[North Atlantic Treaty]] following the incursion. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/sep/10/poland-pm-condemns-repeated-violation-of-airspace-amid-russian-attack-on-ukraine-follow-live?CMP=share_btn_url&page=with%3Ablock-68c136898f084b00adb68014#block-68c136898f084b00adb68014 (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests]]
**[[Nepal]] deploys [[Nepalese Armed Forces|its military]] to enforce an indefinite [[curfew]] in [[Kathmandu]] following anti-[[Corruption in Nepal|corruption]] protests. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/09/10/nepals-army-imposes-curfew-day-after-gen-z-protesters-set-government-buildings-on-fire (Euronews)]
**Kathmandu's [[Tribhuvan International Airport]] reopens nearly a day after the [[Nepali Army]] occupied it. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjd1ndmrej0o (BBC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Belgium–Germany relations]], [[Belgium–Israel relations]]
**A [[music festival]] in [[Ghent]], [[Belgium]], cancels a performance by the [[Munich Philharmonic]] orchestra, citing the [[Israelis|Israeli]] conductor [[Lahav Shani]]'s attitudes towards the [[Israeli government]] as the reason. [https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/europe/2025-09-11/ty-article/.premium/belgium-event-bans-munich-philharmonic-over-israeli-conductors-unclear-netanyahu-stance/00000199-34e7-df32-a1df-34f73e1a0000 (''Haaretz'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Finance in India]]
**[[India]]'s [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|Securities and Exchange Board]] announces that rules exempting [[Foreign direct investment in India|foreign investors]] who purchase only [[government bond]]s from disclosing investor group details will take effect on February 8, 2026. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/india-ease-norms-foreign-investors-buying-only-government-bonds-february-2026-2025-09-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–2025 Cuba blackouts]]
**[[Cuba]] experiences its fifth nationwide [[power outage]] in less than a year, affecting about 10 million people. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/10/cuba-electricity-power-blackout (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 Iztapalapa tank truck explosion]]
**Over 30 people are killed and 90 others are injured after a [[tank truck]] carrying around 49,500 liters (13,000 gallons) of [[Liquefied petroleum gas|LP gas]] explodes at a highway interchange in the [[Iztapalapa]] borough of [[Mexico City]]. The shockwave caused by the explosion set another eighteen cars on fire. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/09/10/americas/mexico-gas-tanker-explosion-latam-intl (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/09/10/world/americas/mexico-city-gas-explosion.html (''The New York Times'')]
*At least 86 people are killed when a boat capsizes in [[Basankusu]], [[Équateur Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-capsized-boat-4771f59a3e6c4192fc2eef3a1426e05b (AP)]
*At least 19 people are killed and six others are missing due to widespread flooding in [[Bali]] and [[East Nusa Tenggara]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-bali-east-nusa-tenggara-flash-floods-d2a52193bb574138faeaa88a11f441d0 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/indonesia-19-dead-after-flash-floods/a-73959609 (DW)]
*Four people are killed when a [[Eurocopter AS350 Écureuil]] crashes into a mountainside in Jila, [[Mimika Regency]], [[Central Papua]], [[Western New Guinea]], Indonesia. [https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/544007 (ASN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Australia]] approves the first vaccine to [[Koala conservation|protect]] [[koala]]s from [[chlamydia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/australia-approves-first-vaccine-save-koalas-chlamydia-2025-09-10/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**[[Scarborough Shoal standoff]]
***[[China]] approves the establishment of a [[List of national nature reserves of China|national nature reserve]] at [[Scarborough Shoal]] in the [[South China Sea]], a territory also claimed by the [[Philippines]] and [[Taiwan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-philippines-scarborough-shoal-nature-reserve-6131d2bd2bc54c53546481609c7ac67c (AP)]
*[[China–United States relations]], [[Space policy of the United States]]
**[[NASA]] confirms that [[Chinese people|Chinese]] citizens, including those holding a valid [[U.S. visa]], are barred from accessing [[NASA facilities|its facilities]] and systems and working on [[List of NASA missions|its programs]], citing [[Cyberwarfare and China|security concerns]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-09-10/nasa-cuts-access-for-chinese-citizens-in-us-beijing-space-salvo (Bloomberg)]
*[[Deportation in the second Trump administration]], [[Ghana–United States relations]]
**[[President of Ghana|Ghanaian president]] [[John Mahama]] announces that [[Ghana]] can accept citizens of [[West Africa]]n nations who have been [[Deportation from the United States|deported]] from the [[United States]] under a regional [[Visa policy of Ghana|visa-free]] travel arrangement. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250911-ghana-agrees-to-take-in-west-africans-deported-by-united-states (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Israel–European Union relations]]
**[[European Commission]] [[President of the European Commission|president]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] announces intentions to seek [[List of sanctions involving Israel|sanctions]] against and a partial suspension of trade with [[Israel]], while also immediately suspending certain bilateral funds, citing the ongoing [[Gaza Strip famine]] as the reason. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2025/09/10/von-der-leyen-begs-eu-governments-punish-israel-famine-gaza/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2025-09-10/von-der-leyen-proposes-bolder-eu-sanctions-against-israel-over-the-war-in-gaza (''Los Angeles Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Solingen stabbings]]
**A [[Germany|German]] [[Judiciary of Germany|state court]] convicts a [[Syrians in Germany|Syrian]] national of [[Murder in German law|murder]], [[attempted murder]], and [[Islamic State]] membership for a 2024 [[mass stabbing]] in [[Solingen]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], sentencing him to [[Life imprisonment in Germany|life imprisonment]] without [[parole]] eligibility after 15 years. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/suspect-convicted-murder-knife-attack-german-festival-sentenced-125428388 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[2025 Vancouver car attack]]
**A [[Court system of Canada|court]] in [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]], rules that a man accused of killing eleven people during a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] in April at a [[Filipino Heritage Month]] event in [[Vancouver]], is [[Competence (law)|mentally fit]] to stand trial. [https://apnews.com/article/vancouver-car-ramming-kaiji-adam-lo-trial-4302048f564253d9722d1563fc14f12b (AP)]
*[[Assassination of Charlie Kirk]]
**[[Americans|American]] [[Right-wing politics in the United States|right-wing political]] activist [[Charlie Kirk]] is [[Assassination|shot dead]] during a debate at [[Utah Valley University]] in [[Orem, Utah]], [[United States]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/sep/10/charlie-kirk-shot-utah (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Far-right politics in Germany (1945–present)|Far-right politics in Germany]]
**[[Public Prosecutor General (Germany)|German public prosecutors]] charge eight suspected members of a [[far-right politics|far-right]] group who plan to secede from [[Saxony]] to create a [[Neo-Nazism|Nazi]] state after the group were discovered in 2024 to be conducting [[paramilitary]] training and amassing weapons. One of the men was a former [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] local politician. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-extremists-charged-with-planning-neo-nazi-state/a-73953237 (DW)]
*[[Human trafficking in South Africa]]
**The [[Gauteng Division of the High Court of South Africa|high court]] in [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]], sentences seven [[Overseas Chinese|Chinese]] nationals to 20 years in [[Prisons in South Africa|prison]] each for [[Human trafficking|trafficking]] 91 [[Malawi]]an workers and [[Forced labour|forcing them to labor]] under abusive conditions at a [[Johannesburg]] factory. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-chinese-human-trafficking-sentence-a72fcba8bfaaa6e967c56d03dc1cf5b0 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–2025 French political crisis]]
**[[First Lecornu government|Lecornu government]], [[Bloquons tout]]
***[[Sébastien Lecornu]] is sworn in as [[Prime Minister of France]] after previous prime minister [[François Bayrou]] failed a [[confidence vote]] on September 8. 
***His appointment coincides with [[France|country-wide]] protests and strikes against austerity measures previously announced by Bayrou, with protestors calling to "[[Bloquons tout|block everything]]". Eighty thousand [[French National Police|police officers]] and [[National Gendarmerie|gendarmes]] are deployed nationwide, with at least 200 people arrested as of 10 a.m. [[Central European Summer Time|local time]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20250910-france-hit-by-block-everything-protests-as-new-pm-lecornu-sworn-in (RFI)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/europe/block-everything-protests-france-macron-budget-cuts-rcna230265 (NBC News)]
*The [[Australian government]] announces plans to bolster its [[Australia Defence Force|military]] through a US$1.1 billion fleet of ''[[Ghost Shark (submarine)|Ghost Shark]]'' [[Unmanned underwater vehicle|underwater drones]], with the first batch delivered to the [[Australian Navy]] in January 2026. [https://www.dw.com/en/australia-to-spend-11-billion-on-ghost-shark-drone-subs/a-73942165 (DW)]
*The [[Sri Lanka]]n [[Parliament of Sri Lanka|parliament]] votes 151–1 to abolish state-funded benefits, including housing, [[pension]]s, transport, and office staff, for former [[President of Sri Lanka|presidents]] and [[First Lady of Sri Lanka|their spouses]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sri-lanka-presidential-perks-funding-1808d8cc640b9b5a4631dd5fe89e5af6 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Life on Mars]] 
**An article published in ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'' announces that the ''[[Perseverance (rover)|Perseverance]]'' rover discovered [[vivianite]], [[greigite]], and various [[organic compound]]s in rocks at [[Cheyava Falls]] on [[Mars]], in what [[Administrator of NASA|NASA administrator]] [[Sean Duffy]] says may be "the clearest [[Biosignature|sign of life]] that we've ever found on Mars". [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/09/10/science/mars-rock-nasa-perserverance.html (''The New York Times'')]
